course.title: Transportation Planning
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: The Dhaka metro rail system was expected to connect key areas of Dhaka, providing a faster an more efficient mode of transportation for the residents. Passengers are getting on and off the metro rail at all 16 stations on the Uttara-Motizheel route.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2022
